title: 5th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/5/1/2026).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 2026/1/1 to 2026/1/4).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021) for appointing non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to foreign countries is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021) for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Bosnia and Herzegovina is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of Serbia and the Republic of Malta.
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to Oman.
Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's submission for appointing a non-resident ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of Armenia.
Report of the National Development and Heritage Committee on the Bill to amend the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The Ramadan sitting was scheduled to approve old minutes, send new ambassador nominations to committee, continue the National Service Bill, and take up committee reports on three ambassadors and the Employment Act amendment.
